# Next.js App Router — Component Catalog

This file documents the shared components that live under `app/(core)/_components/` and the layout/shell components under `app/(app)/_components/`. Browse this catalog **before building any new component** — there is likely already one that fits.

For implementation patterns by screen type, see `frontend/patterns/`.

---

## Component map (overview)

| Component | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `ScreenWrapper` | `(core)/_components/ScreenWrapper.tsx` | Required wrapper around every Screen — padding + max-width |
| `PageHeader` | `(core)/_components/PageHeader.tsx` | Title + description + actions row |
| `LoadingButton` | `(core)/_components/LoadingButton.tsx` | Button that shows spinner + disables during async work |
| `LoadingIndicator` | `(core)/_components/LoadingIndicator.tsx` | Plain spinner |
| `NavigationButton` | `(core)/_components/NavigationButton.tsx` | Link-style button with icon |
| `ScrollableTabs` | `(core)/_components/ScrollableTabs.tsx` | Horizontally scrollable tab bar |
| `RequiredMark` | `(core)/_components/RequiredMark.tsx` | Red asterisk for required fields |
| `Input` | `(core)/_components/Input.tsx` | Project-wide TextInput wrapper |
| `FloatingActionButton` | `(core)/_components/FloatingActionButton.tsx` | Single-action FAB |
| `SubMenuFAB` | `(core)/_components/SubMenuFAB.tsx` | FAB that expands to multiple actions |
| `NavigationFAB` | `(core)/_components/NavigationFAB.tsx` | App-shell FAB driven by FABContext |
| `FABChildItem` | `(core)/_components/FABChildItem.tsx` | Single action chip used inside SubMenuFAB |
| `FormBackButton` | `(core)/_components/FormBackButton.tsx` | Back-arrow used inside forms |
| `LevelIcon` | `(core)/_components/LevelIcon.tsx` | Level badge icon |

## When to use what

### Need a button?

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| Plain submit / click action | Mantine `<Button>` |
| Triggers an async operation (API call) | `<LoadingButton>` |
| Navigates to another page | `<NavigationButton href={...}>` |
| Icon-only button | Mantine `<ActionIcon>` |
| Primary screen action floating over content | `<FloatingActionButton>` |
| Multiple actions floating | `<SubMenuFAB items={...}>` |

### Need a layout container?

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| Outer container for every Screen | `<ScreenWrapper>` (mandatory) |
| Page title + action row | `<PageHeader title="..." actions={...}>` |
| Horizontal tab navigation | `<ScrollableTabs tabs={...} value={...} onChange={...}>` |
| Stack of items (vertical) | Mantine `<Stack>` |
| Inline elements (horizontal) | Mantine `<Group>` |
| Card surface | Mantine `<Card>` or `<Paper>` |

### Need a form input?

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| Wrap input with label + error | Mantine `<Input.Wrapper label="..." error={...}>` |
| Text input | Mantine `<TextInput>` (or project `<Input>` wrapper) |
| Number input | Mantine `<NumberInput>` |
| Date input | Mantine `<DateInput>` (`@mantine/dates`) |
| Select | Mantine `<Select>` or `<MultiSelect>` |
| Multi-line text | Mantine `<Textarea>` |
| Tag/chip input | Mantine `<PillsInput>` |
| Toggle | Mantine `<Switch>` |
| Required field marker | `<RequiredMark />` |

### Need a feedback UI?

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| Loading overlay (covering content) | Mantine `<LoadingOverlay>` |
| Inline spinner | `<LoadingIndicator>` |
| Toast (success / failure) | `toast.success("...")` / `toast.error("...")` (`react-hot-toast`) |
| Inline alert message | Mantine `<Alert>` |
| Confirmation dialog (rich) | `modals.openConfirmModal({ ... })` (`@mantine/modals`) |
| Confirmation dialog (simple, in mutation) | `window.confirm("...")` |

### Need a modal?

See `frontend/patterns/dialog.md`. Quick rule: file suffix `*Popup` or `*Modal`, props are `opened` + `close`.

## Detailed reference — required components

### ScreenWrapper

Wraps every Screen body. Applies padding, max-width, and `Box pos="relative"` so `LoadingOverlay` works.

```tsx
import { ScreenWrapper } from "@/app/(core)/_components/ScreenWrapper"

export const MyScreen = () => (
  <ScreenWrapper>
    {/* everything renders inside */}
  </ScreenWrapper>
)
```

### PageHeader

Top-of-page banner with title, optional description, and action buttons on the right.

```tsx
<PageHeader
  title="家族クエスト一覧"
  description="家族のクエストを管理します"
  actions={
    <Button onClick={handleCreate}>新規作成</Button>
  }
/>
```

### LoadingButton

Use whenever a click triggers an async operation. Prevents double-submit and shows a spinner.

```tsx
<LoadingButton loading={isLoading} onClick={handleSubmit}>
  保存する
</LoadingButton>
```

### ScrollableTabs

Horizontally scrollable tab bar. Tabs render inside as `<Tabs.Panel>`.

```tsx
<ScrollableTabs
  activeTab={tab}
  onChange={setTab}
  tabs={[
    { value: "basic",   label: "基本",   rightSection: hasBasicErrors  ? <IconAlertCircle size={16} color="red" /> : null },
    { value: "details", label: "詳細",   rightSection: hasDetailErrors ? <IconAlertCircle size={16} color="red" /> : null },
  ]}
>
  <Tabs.Panel value="basic">...</Tabs.Panel>
  <Tabs.Panel value="details">...</Tabs.Panel>
</ScrollableTabs>
```

`rightSection` is the place to surface tab-level errors / unread badges / counts.

### RequiredMark

Place inside `<Input.Wrapper>` label to mark required fields.

```tsx
<Input.Wrapper label={<>クエスト名 <RequiredMark /></>} error={errors.name?.message}>
  <Input {...register("name")} />
</Input.Wrapper>
```

### FloatingActionButton / SubMenuFAB

Floats above content; mobile-friendly entry point for primary actions.

```tsx
<SubMenuFAB items={[
  { label: "新規作成", icon: <IconPlus />,  onClick: handleCreate },
  { label: "削除",     icon: <IconTrash />, onClick: handleDelete, danger: true },
]} />
```

For app-shell-wide FAB customization (so the same FAB serves multiple screens), use `FABContext` + `NavigationFAB`:

```tsx
import { useFAB } from "@/app/(core)/_components/FABContext"
import { useEffect } from "react"

const MyScreen = () => {
  const { setFabActions } = useFAB()
  useEffect(() => {
    setFabActions([{ label: "保存", icon: <IconCheck />, onClick: handleSave }])
    return () => setFabActions([])
  }, [])
}
```

## Context providers

| Context | Hook | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `FABContext` | `useFAB()` | Override the app-shell FAB per screen |
| `LoadingContext` | `useLoading()` | Show a global loading indicator from anywhere |
| `BackgroundContext` | `useBackground()` | Set per-screen background image/color |
| `ThemeContext` | `useTheme()` | Light/dark theme + Mantine theme overrides |

Add a context only when the data must cross multiple unrelated routes; see `state-management.md`.

---

## App shell (read-only — do not modify when working on a feature)

`app/(app)/_components/` defines the global layout. These are the responsibility of layout-level PRs only.

| Component | Role |
|---|---|
| `AppShellContent` | Picks SideMenu (PC) or BottomBar (mobile) based on `useMediaQuery` |
| `SideMenu` | PC sidebar with navigation links + user avatar |
| `BottomBar` | Mobile tab bar fixed to bottom |
| `AppHeader` | Top bar with logo/back button |
| `BackgroundWrapper` | Renders background per `BackgroundContext` |
| `ThemeToggleButton` | Light/dark switch |

---

## Component-search-first rule

Before writing any new UI element:

1. **Check this catalog** — is there an existing component for this role?
2. **Check Mantine** — does Mantine provide one? (Almost always yes)
3. **Only if neither exists** — create a new one in `app/(core)/_components/` and add it here

When in doubt, ask: "is this the third time we're rendering this kind of thing?" If yes, extract.

---

## Constraints

- Every Screen must use `<ScreenWrapper>` — no exceptions
- `_components/` is the only place for screen-specific components; `app/(core)/_components/` is the only place for shared ones
- Do not duplicate Mantine — wrap Mantine if you must adapt it, don't reinvent
- `RequiredMark` is mandatory on every required form field's label
- `LoadingButton` is mandatory on any button that triggers a mutation
- `ScrollableTabs` carries the `rightSection` slot — use it for tab-level error indicators
